purpose: Resolve the Paper B primary endpoint before any authority-ladder scientific execution.

ret_2017.known_issue: The inspected workbook contains values slightly above 1 and a policy-dependent observed-order population.

confirmed_audit_findings: The 2017 thesis declares ReT normalized on a 0-to-1 scale.
Rsult_1.xlsx contains ReT values above 1 by at most 0.000155.
Clipping those values to 1 leaves the mean ranking of Cf1-Cf12 unchanged.
Deleting observations above 1 or deleting the full tail is not an authorized correction.
The Re sheet and the Cf sheets are not the same population.
The inspected workbooks do not contain the 2024 Cobb-Douglas formula.
The inspected workbooks are insufficient to attribute a published ranking reversal.
required_negative_checks: Reject a metric contract with any unresolved blocking decision.
Reject maxima calibrated on evaluation or confirmation data.
Reject a kappa normalization whose comparison set is not frozen.
Reject a tau proxy substituted for the published ratio without explicit amendment.
Reject deletion of out-of-range workbook observations as if it were clipping.
Reject reuse of the historical Garrido-2024 implementation as paper-faithful authority without a new audit.
